description: This is a PHPUnit test class for the EmployeeDependentService within the OrangeHRM project. It tests various methods such as retrieving, saving, deleting, and searching employee dependents, using mock objects for data access and dependencies.

classes.name: EmployeeDependentServiceTest
classes.description: PHPUnit test class for EmployeeDependentService, testing methods like retrieval, save, delete, search and count functionalities related to employee dependents.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Prepares the test environment by initializing the EmployeeDependentService and populating test data.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeDependents
methods.description: Tests retrieving a list of dependents for a specific employee ID.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeDependent
methods.description: Tests retrieving a specific employee dependent by employee and dependent IDs.

methods.name: testSaveEmployeeDependent
methods.description: Tests saving a new employee dependent and verifies the saved details.

methods.name: testDeleteEmployeeDependents
methods.description: Tests deleting dependents for an employee and verifies the number of rows affected.

methods.name: testSearchEmployeeDependent
methods.description: Tests searching for dependents using filter parameters.

methods.name: testGetSearchEmployeeDependentsCount
methods.description: Tests counting the number of dependents matching search criteria.
